## 1. AEG-MUS-01 · Aegis: second reader on Gemini's California homeowners insurance facts

**Due:** 2026-12-12 · **State:** next (starts when the file it checks is in the folder)

**Why:** Nothing Gemini delivers is built on until a second reader has checked it.

**What it unlocks:** Claude builds from the file only after this check.

**Read first:**
- Gemini's file aegis_gemini_ca-homeowners_*.json in the folder below (AEG-GEM-01)

**Do this:**
1. Open Gemini's file. Pick 12 rows at random (every row if fewer).
